learning_salience.rationale: Dominant coverage of gateway KP kp_cs230_frontier_model_diagnostic_evidence_lenses; concrete signal is the 200B checkpoint failure case organized into training/scaling, representations/internals, data/distribution, and capabilities/safety evidence lenses.

Dominant coverage of kp_saliency_via_input_gradients plus substantial kp_cs230_integrated_gradients; formula-heavy attribution segment teaches pre-softmax gradient saliency, baseline-to-image integrated gradients, and common misinterpretation signals.

Substantial coverage of two high-importance interpretability KPs, kp_cs230_occlusion_sensitivity and kp_cs230_class_activation_maps_with_global_average_pooling; concrete signals include scan-mask score drops, global average pooling, and class-specific weighted feature-map localization.

Substantial coverage of activation optimization and data-set search KPs; formula-heavy signal includes fixed-weight gradient ascent on input pixels, pre-softmax objectives, regularization, and retrieval of high-activation validation examples.

Dominant coverage of supporting medium-importance KP kp_cs230_deconvolution_as_transposed_convolution; concrete signal is the y=Wx convolution-as-matrix derivation and W-transpose intuition, but it is narrower support for interpretability rather than a gateway concept.

Dominant coverage of supporting medium-importance KP kp_cs230_deconvnet_reconstruction_and_unpooling_switches with demo-heavy visual reconstruction; concrete signal is the reverse path through unpooling switches, ReLU, and deconvolution, plus a toolkit summary, but details are partly visual and narrower.

Dominant coverage of high-importance KP kp_cs230_transformer_representation_analysis plus substantial support from kp_cs230_attention_map_and_embedding_diagnostics; concrete signal is the comparison between CNN localized features and transformer attention/embedding relationships, though the segment is high-level.

Substantial coverage of high-importance KPs kp_cs230_loss_curves_and_training_telemetry and kp_pretraining_scaling_and_compute_data_tradeoffs; concrete signals include loss jumps, gradient norms, learning-rate schedules, hardware telemetry, and Chinchilla-style undertraining diagnosis.

Substantial coverage of benchmark contamination and safety-evaluation KPs, including critical KP kp_benchmark_contamination; concrete signals include n-gram/hash/embedding contamination checks, held-out replacement, release dashboards, and RLHF targeting based on failing evals.

Dominant coverage of high-importance KP kp_cs230_data_distribution_and_token_drift_diagnostics; concrete signal is domain proportion tracking, token-frequency drift, tokenizer statistics, and MoE router metrics, with item density lowered by the closing Q&A.
